exposure: length of second stage of labor
cohort: Newborns delivered at public health facilities in Dilla town, Southern Ethiopia, with 534 participants (178 cases with Apgar score <7 and 356 controls with Apgar score >=7).
finding: No antenatal care follow-up, instrumental mode of delivery, non-vertex presentation, prolonged second stage of labor, and gestational hypertension were significantly associated with a low fifth minute Apgar score.
mod_finding: Instrumental mode of delivery was significantly associated with a low fifth minute Apgar score.
